product.olivetti-snx-160.summary: The 1994 Systema with room for a second Pentium.
product.olivetti-snx-160.history: In 1994, the SNX 160 sat above the SNX 140 in Olivetti’s network server range. The SNX 160E replaced it in April 1995.
product.olivetti-snx-160.architecture: The second processor fitted on the same card. The GO898, GO2060 and GO2082 accept another 90 MHz Pentium.
product.olivetti-snx-160.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
